title: Play AC Online talk pools file (api 2)
description: Villager line pools: on an ordinary talk (never a special or event talk) where no script said a line, a villager says at most one data line a day (today's event lines first, else the most specific matching pools: this villager, else this personality, else everyone), then their own hello. Either scope; runs in the City too. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

villager.description: A villager's name, any case. Not with personality.

chance.description: Days in 100 the pool speaks to a villager. Default 100.

items.description: A villager line: 1 to 160 characters, at most 3 line breaks.
